decision: Use explicit native Document/Application policy for C++/Python and live Window-owned global history policy for both ImGui contexts. Reuse existing history/settings consumers; do not model these as frozen kernel options or detached_options.

history_memory_mb.zero: No obsolete-pixel byte cap; step cap still applies.

limits: Existing source tests supply reusable predicates only; no historical test execution identity was reviewed or promoted here.
minimal_effect_contract: Fresh8/0 plus ten changed edits retains8 undo states.
Lower steps to2 immediately; exact pixels/revisions/dirty unchanged, then Undo restores exact prior pixels.
128x256 eager double planes:1MiB retains four obsolete262144-byte planes; steps2 retains524288 bytes.
Detached Settings mutation does not affect native owners until explicit application; Window live policy has no per-command frozen override.
Persist3/1 and reopen/new/session-owner adoption yields3/1048576 with empty reopened history.
Both actual ImGui launches edit the two integer fields and Apply; Defaults/Revert/draft close have independent commit assertions.
next_owned_output: Add the two complete typed requirement/consumer assignments after the live-policy/failure disposition is frozen, implement the two atomicity repairs, then bind genuine effect/reopen/physical-UI assertions. No repeated25-key inventory or existing-predicate pass assumption.
observed_source_semantics: Applying a native policy prunes immediately without pixel/revision/dirty edits; undo/redo step caps apply separately.
Obsolete eager double pixel buffers are deduplicated; byte pruning removes oldest undo then redo. External snapshots are outside policy ownership and virtual accounting can be incomplete.
Window reapplies both live preferences on every consumeSettings call to open/new/reopened/staged-output owners, overriding any direct per-document policy.
Session reopen yields clean owners/empty history; Window supplies its current policy. History stacks/policy are not restored from sessions.

required_repairs_before_atomic_claims.exit: Prepare all document policy/pruning effects before committing preferences and owners, with bounded injected-failure atomicity checks.
required_repairs_before_atomic_claims.gap: updateSettings may persist/assign preferences before sequential policy pruning throws, allowing partial application.

required_repairs_before_atomic_claims.exit: Prepare adoption/policy effects and publish atomically; failed adoption leaves supplied histories/owners unchanged.
required_repairs_before_atomic_claims.gap: addDocument/addSessionDocuments may prune caller-owned unattached documents before later adoption allocation succeeds.
